In this text, their distribution, organization and articulation are analyzed in the M\u00e4laren region of central\u2010eastern Sweden. The study shows that the petroglyphs are organized in relation to water as well as to different minerals visible in the rock. This pattern indicates that they are not simply images or symbols but also physical \u2018devices\u2019, produced to do something. It is argued that one purpose was for the frequent single podomorphs to be paired with another at a later stage. Because podomorphs in a pair generally are of different sizes and form, it is suggested that each one belongs to an individual of different age and\/or sex \u2013 potentially depicted in stone to show existing or desired future relations, agreements, pacts, friendship, marriages etc.<\/jats:p>","DOI":"10.1111\/ojoa.70020","type":"journal-article","created":{"date-parts":[[2026,5,7]],"date-time":"2026-05-07T05:55:32Z","timestamp":1778133332000},"page":"330-348","update-policy":"https:\/\/doi.org\/10.1002\/crossmark_policy","source":"Crossref","is-referenced-by-count":0,"title":["A STEP IN STONE.
